system.description:
This urban combat drone is designed to storm entrenched positions without endangering soldiers, police, but it can easily be replicated by private individuals with access to the necessary resources and technical expertise. A LUT drone has a multispectral sensor package that eliminates penalties for smoke, fog, or low-light conditions, and adds +2 to tests to examine the environment. Its primary function is combat, however, and to that end it can carry 10 lbs. of ordnance. Standard loads include the following:

One PDW with two integrated reloads.

One grenade launcher (SS, 50-yard range) with five grenades or the user’s choice preloaded.

Speed/Velocity: Fast/+1. Armor Rating: 5/7. Health: 30. Automation: Standard.
